This battle marked the Muslims' first major victory in Syria.

The name Luwaibid is derived from the Arabic word 'luwiba', meaning 'a place of rest or shelter'. This name was given to the site of the battle as it was a strategic location with abundant water sources, which proved to be crucial in the outcome of the battle.
